text: What the fuck is wrong with me?
I had a thought that something is wrong with me.
The message is that I'm not meeting my own standards.
What should I believe in order to seem that way?
I believe that by spending so much time on it, I should already have the results.
So what should I do with that?
I should review my expectations and I should put more focus on the right things to do.
Changing your life is not happening overnight.
So follow me and let's do this together.
